name: Mini Glazed Meatloaves with Mashed Potatoes & Roasted Carrots

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince onion; place in a medium bowl.
Add ground beef, egg, milk, bread crumbs, salt, and pepper to the bowl with the onions. Mix with your hands until well combined.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ lb lean ground beef
1 egg
whole milk
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place ketchup, Dijon, and brown sugar in a small bowl; whisk to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tbsp ketchup
1 tsp Dijon mustard
½ tsp brown sugar

instructions.primary_message: Divide meatloaf mixture between 6 muffin cups and top with ketchup glaze. Place in the oven and bake until cooked through, 20-25 minutes.

Meanwhile, wash, peel, and medium dice potato. Transfer to a medium saucepan, cover with hot water (from the tap), and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium and cook until potatoes can be easily pierced with a fork, 10-12 minutes.

Wash, trim, and peel carrots. Slice lengthwise into quarters. Place on a baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, and season with salt and pepper. Place in the oven and bake until golden and fork-tender, about 10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 medium carrots
2 tsp extra virgin olive oil
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the potatoes are done, drain, and return to the pan.
Add milk, butter, salt, and pepper to the potatoes. Mash until smooth.
instructions.secondary_message:
whole milk
2 tsp butter, unsalted
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide the meatloaves, roasted carrots, and mashed potatoes between plates. Enjoy!
